text: If Bonfire Night, 5 November, falls on a Saturday, what day of the week is Halloween?
why: Halloween, 31 October, is five days earlier: Saturday back five days is Monday.

text: A bonfire is lit at 6:45pm and burns for 2 hours 40 minutes. What time does it go out?
why: 6:45 plus 2 hours is 8:45, plus 40 minutes is 9:25.
